title: Independently check #4436 expanded compiler counts (no new κ)
body:
PR #4476 explicitly leaves the fully expanded rank-mass identity from zxv’s #4436 outside its width/routing audit. This package independently checks that boundary, retaining every source complement, paid exit and integer batch multiplicity. It corroborates `B_n n − P_n = Δ Q_n` and `U_n ≤ Q_n ≤ B_n n/Δ` for positive surplus; no new construction or κ is claimed.

The separate ordered-word flow and counted expansion reproduce all five published totals for both toy compilations through rank 100 and raw p7 through rank 1,000. Forty-four small programs are also traversed literally, and 14 semantic controls reject omitted complements, wrong multiplicities, missing instances, nonintegral batches and related faults. The universal induction and bank-count qualifications are in `PROOF.md`.

Validation: Python 3.12.15 registered replay and metadata/pins pass; committed-byte/source-history preflight and checked 19-file export pass; the exported verifier passes with `-I -O -B`, no Git and `PATH=/nonexistent`. Changed-source and changed-receipt controls reject. Native/physical execution, record grammar, precision constants, exponent convergence and outer theorem admission remain unverified. The historical orientation-helper failure remains recorded separately; no baseline PASS is claimed.

Sources: #4436 at `56003680aee2871773de408e5f01cc5dd46b144c`, #4476 at `4e7022aa9128c8673d3e2024052b2deaa18cb6e4`; research baseline `2a13eb1827784206202db90e5dc8327cf8a250db`, priority revision 7. Submission was refreshed against canonical main `f9f85c1e4fa1e955ff39f10fca447e3e2a4e4adc`; the branch includes it while preserving frozen source pins. The research overlap scan covered all 352 open PR bodies and bounded Discussion views, with a fresh submission check for duplicates and newer work. #4483’s changed-height convergence theorem and #4507’s narrower chronological batch widths are distinct from this expanded-instance audit.

Credit zxv for the construction/count theorem, Jacob Alan Sussman for the compiler, Ryanson Jonathan for #4456/#4476 and the explicit coverage gap, Cinna Davis for raw p7, and their retained native/outer predecessors. Prepared by Dillon with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate AI-agent review; no independent human or formal-kernel verification. Only the new scoped package is changed; source exports and notices are retained unchanged.
